registration_timing: Seal identity features, candidate IDs, pair IDs, registry hash, and protocol hash before outcome generation or reveal.
primary_analysis: Paired intervention-minus-matched-random effect within each identity stratum, with a two-sided run-replicate-cluster sign-flip test.

stop_rules.signed_edit_below_holonomy_clean: Record as unauthorized engineering evidence; do not relabel.

clean_conclusion: At identity strata represented by valid matched pairs, intervention effects are reported only relative to matched-random edits within the same preregistered stratum.
